name: Foxtail Pricklegrass
desc: Foxtail Pricklegrass (Sporobolus alopecuroides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Sporobolus alopecuroides is a species of grass known by the common name foxtail pricklegrass. It is native to Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.
